rubric.type: The chart type fits the intent and the shape of the result.
rubric.roles: The right columns hold the right roles.
rubric.title: The title says what is shown, in the caller's language, and is true.
rubric.units: Units and number formats are right.
rubric.honest: Nothing misleads: zero baseline, sort, readable labels, emphasis on what was asked.
rubric.explanation: The explanation is honest and in the caller's language.

actual_fine_distribution.note: Ten equal-width bins in ascending order with their counts, computed in resolving; the fines cluster at both ends. The package colours each bin differently; one colour would read better.
actual_fine_distribution.spec:
vis histogram
title Distribution of Actual Fine Amounts
description A histogram showing the frequency of actual fine amounts across all violations.
axisXTitle Actual Fine Amount (SAR)
axisYTitle Number of Violations
binNumber 10
bind
  value actual_fine
